name: Sullivan house
status: proposed (address); design interpreted from the brief (no reference photo)
materials: weathered (unpainted) cedar shakes, silver-grey with brown strays, 5.5 in exposure
white painted trim, wide corner boards, belt course, K-style gutters
white 6-over-6 double-hung windows; teal-blue glazed front door
dark grey architectural asphalt shingles, 12:12 pitch
red brick exterior chimney; painted block foundation; white lattice skirt
screened porch: shingled knee wall, bronze screen panels, beadboard ceiling
brick paver walk, crushed-shell driveway with a concrete apron
notes: Main block 13.2 x 9.0 m, floor 0.9 m up on a block foundation, 12:12 side-gable roof with three gabled front dormers, ridge 8.4 m (Atlas 8.5 m). Screened porch 5.0 x 7.0 m on the left (toward the Rossis) with a French door into the house and a screen door with steps to the side yard. All of the design is interpreted from the brief; there is no reference photo. The Atlas footprint (21.4 x 16.8 m) is larger than a cottage needs: the house plus porch fill 19.6 m of its width. Lot sides use corrected neighbor sides (site-specs.json neighbors_local x is mirrored): the Rossi house is on the left at (-40.1, 1.0), rotated -9.5 deg. Main block centred 0.8 m right of the footprint centre so the screened porch stays within 0.2 m of the footprint.
